text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Mom, Dad, thank you for the letter. I was 
surprised too that that photo of me 
spacing out at the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies became such a hot topic!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because of TV? People on the street 
keep calling me the 'Snow Angel' and 
all... I've been feeling restless the 
whole time."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Still, a boom is my big chance...! Bein' 
called cute makes me happy and all, but 
I'll work hard so they think I'm totally 
cool!"
